sections.Profile:
Accept bounties and escape impossible odds as the eponymous intergalactic bounty hunter of the Disney+ Star Wars series, teaming up with allies to protect Grogu while fending off ambushes. Designed by Brian Eddy, the game includes custom speech recorded by Carl Weathers as Greef Karga.

- Manufacturer: Stern Pinball Inc.
- Years made: 2021
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: LCD
- Players: 4
- Tags: 2020s, Licensed, Space, Solid State, Star Wars, Disney, TV Show, Fantasy, Sci-Fi
